orientations.intent: Determine whether any available tools (repo, tests, git, episodes) can publish a checklist to a remote release system.
Determine whether the tests tool can publish a checklist to a remote release system.
Determine whether the git tool can publish a checklist to a remote release system.
Determine whether the episodes tool can publish a checklist to a remote release system.

final_message: No — none of these tools (repo, tests, git, episodes) can publish a checklist to a remote release system. The tests, git, and episodes handles explicitly report that this capability is unavailable in the reachable world, and the repo tool only exposes local status/inspection capabilities (currently showing branch `master`, clean working tree) with no publishing or remote-release functionality found.
